title: Northbeam TechWorks Included Visit Pool: Accounting Instruction
content:
Included visits on Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair are accounted for as one pool belonging to the customer profile.

## Clause 1 — the pool and its drawing

The clause that included visits are pooled across the profile rather than counted job by job is **no longer in force**, having been superseded by the current basis for the pool a relief is worked out against. What the pool is drawn against, and in what order, still stands as follows: the visits used in the term are set against the visits included by every agreement the profile holds, and the pool is drawn down in the order the visits were granted, oldest grant first.

The visits used in the term are the visits actually carried out against the included allowance, read over the current visit term — from the day the visits were granted to the last day of the visit term months of the TechWorks service in question.

## Clause 2 — the order of grounds within the pool

Visits granted under a protection plan are drawn before visits granted by a membership, and visits granted as goodwill are drawn last. The drawing order of the pool is therefore: protection plan visits, then membership visits, then goodwill visits.

## Clause 3 — an empty pool

Where the pool is empty the visit is carried out and billed as ordinary labour, and the customer is told which grant ran out.

## Clause 4 — a failed attendance

A visit that ends as a failed attendance is not drawn from the pool, because no work was carried out.

## Clause 5 — the end of a term

Unused visits do not carry into the next term and are not paid out.

## Worked illustration of the drawing order

A hypothetical profile holds three grants in the current term: two visits granted by a membership on an earlier day, one visit granted under a protection plan on a later day, and one granted as goodwill later still. Two visits have been used. Clause 2 governs the ground before clause 1 governs the day: the protection plan visit is drawn first, and the second visit drawn is the older of the two membership grants. One membership visit and the goodwill visit remain in the pool. Had a third visit ended as a failed attendance, the pool would still stand at those two.

The per-service figures this instruction reads — the visits a TechWorks service includes in its term, the months that term runs and the planned maintenance visits it carries each year — are carried in the entitlement schedule for each of the six TechWorks services.
